name: IdempotentReceiver
summary: Can receive the same message twice without doing it twice, so that a sender is free to resend whenever it is unsure the first one arrived.

roles.name: IdempotentReceiver
roles.summary: A receiver for which handling a message once and handling it three times have the same effect — reached either by discarding duplicates or by giving the message semantics that survive repetition. It is an assertion about behaviour that no signature carries, and the only thing that makes a resend safe.
